Al final del grupo, sosteniendo el farol: At the back of the group, holding the lantern, walks the hooded figure — not at the front, leading, but at the back, making sure no one is left behind. That place is no accident: true protectors don't need to go first. They go where they're needed, making sure the future seen on the horizon arrives for everyone walking toward it, not just for the one out front.
Al frente camina una mujer. No es casual: At the front walks a woman. It's no accident that she leads: she represents the continuation of humanity, the hope that keeps moving forward even when the path isn't guaranteed. Behind her, an elderly couple moves more slowly — they are wisdom, respect, the structure on which everything else is built. They don't walk alone: a couple of two men walks beside the old man, holding him, protecting him; a couple of two women accompanies the old woman, the same way. They're not there to fill a quota — they're there because that's exactly what real unity looks like: understanding, tolerance for changing times, proof that caring for those who gave us our foundation doesn't depend on whom the caregiver loves.
